messages.subject: McDonald's NCI
parts:
This message is more for Yves, but others might be interested.

I am wondering if it would be possible to add McDonald's (1989) Non-centrality Index as one of the options in the fitMeasures() function. I have written a homemade function that will use the innards of a fitted lavaan model and produce the index, but it would be easier if if were an option. I pasted my function below in case it might be of interest to other users and/or make adding the Mc to lavaan easier.


#Function to calculate McDonald's NCI
Mc <- function (object, digits=3){
fit <- inspect(object, "fit") # lavaan's default output
chisq <- unlist(fit["chisq"]) #model Chi-square
df <- unlist(fit["df"]) # model df
n <- object@SampleStats@ntotal 
ncp <- max(chisq - df,0)  #non-centrality parameter
d <- ncp/(n-1)  #scaled non-centrality parameter
#McDonald's non-centrality index
Mc <- exp((d)*-.5)  
#Print the value
Mc 
}

# Example Use
HS.model<-'visual =~x1+x2+x3 
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)
Mc(fit)

McDonald, R. P. (1989). An index of goodness-of-fit based on noncentrality. Journal of Classification, 6(1), 97-103. doi: 10.1007/bf01908590

Best, 

Alex
